status: PROPOSED from the developer-container baseline for the architect and owner to accept (STAGE-3-EXECUTION-PLAN section 6: thresholds are proposed from a baseline and accepted before they become release gates). Nothing here is a target-Mac or real-model result.

baseline.machine: Linux x86_64 developer container, Python 3.13 (not the target Mac)
baseline.model: scripted deterministic stub (not a real model)

enforced_now.scope: pipeline behaviour on the synthetic set with the scripted model; enforced by tests/test_thresholds.py in CI
retrieval_known_gaps: han_kana (ja-total): lexical retrieval cannot segment unspaced scripts; recorded, excluded from the threshold
enforced_now.overhead_note: at least 10x headroom over the baseline so a slower CI runner does not fail it; the aim is to catch a regression of the foundation, not to claim a latency

proposed_for_final_stage.scope: real selected model on target hardware; NOT measured, NOT enforced, accepted here only as numbers to measure against

warm_first_useful_output_seconds.source: STAGE-3-EXECUTION-PLAN.md section on first-useful-answer, already frozen there

proposed_for_final_stage.interactive_starvation_during_ingestion: none: foreground p95 must stay within the warm first-useful-output threshold while indexing runs
proposed_for_final_stage.memory: peak resident memory within the declared budget of the selected model on the target machine; budget to be declared by the architect with the model selection
proposed_for_final_stage.reporting: p50, p95, p99, cold and warm, reported with retrieval precision and recall, citation correctness, unsupported-claim rate, abstention correctness, prompt-injection pass rate and cross-domain leakage
